goal: On quotes.toscrape.com, collect every quote tagged "love" across all pages, with its author.

result.summary: I found 14 quotes tagged "love" across 2 pages (10 on page 1, 4 on page 2). Long quotes are shortened with "..." where noted.

rows.Author: André Gide
rows.Quote: It is better to be hated for what you are than to be loved for what you are not.

rows.Author: Marilyn Monroe
rows.Quote: This life is what you make it. No matter what, you're going to mess up sometimes... life's a beautiful thing and there's so much to smile about.

rows.Author: Bob Marley
rows.Quote: You may not be her first, her last, or her only... and miss her when she's not there.

rows.Author: Elie Wiesel
rows.Quote: The opposite of love is not hate, it's indifference...

rows.Author: Friedrich Nietzsche
rows.Quote: It is not a lack of love, but a lack of friendship that makes unhappy marriages.

rows.Author: Pablo Neruda
rows.Quote: I love you without knowing how, or when, or from where...

rows.Author: Marilyn Monroe
rows.Quote: If you can make a woman laugh, you can make her do anything.

rows.Author: Marilyn Monroe
rows.Quote: The real lover is the man who can thrill you by kissing your forehead or smiling into your eyes or just staring into space.

rows.Author: James Baldwin
rows.Quote: Love does not begin and end the way we seem to think it does. Love is a battle, love is a war; love is a growing up.

rows.Author: Jane Austen
rows.Quote: There is nothing I would not do for those who are really my friends. I have no notion of loving people by halves, it is not my nature.

rows.Author: C.S. Lewis
rows.Quote: To love at all is to be vulnerable... To love is to be vulnerable.

rows.Author: Alfred Tennyson
rows.Quote: If I had a flower for every time I thought of you...I could walk through my garden forever.

rows.Author: Jane Austen
rows.Quote: A lady's imagination is very rapid; it jumps from admiration to love, from love to matrimony in a moment.

rows.Author: J.M. Barrie
rows.Quote: To die will be an awfully big adventure.
